{{Top}}
{{Otheruses|Minister of Finance}}
The '''Minister of Finance''' oversaw the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Finance Ministry]], and sat as a member of the [[Alliance Cabinet/Legends|Alliance Cabinet]]. The Minister of Finance was directly responsible for the creation and management of the Alliance's budget, taxes, flotation of [[Alliance War Bond]]s, printing of [[Alliance Credit]]s and balancing of all incomes and expenditures.<ref name="RASB">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref>

Until his death in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], [[Viscount (title)/Legends|Viscount]] [[Tardi]] served as Minister of Finance.<ref name="SW48">[[Star Wars (1977) 48|''Star Wars'' (1977) 48]]</ref>
